title: This Eel Zapped 860 Volts, a Record for Any Animal

scenes.text: An electric eel just zapped 860 volts.
That is more than seven times the voltage of a US wall socket.
Scientists measured it in a newly discovered species.
It is the highest voltage ever recorded from a living animal.
The fish can grow to about two and a half metres long.

description:
An electric eel discharged 860 volts, the highest ever recorded from any animal.
The species can grow to about 2.5 metres and 22 kilograms.
Would you swim in a river with one?
first_comment: Which animal has the best natural superpower, in your opinion?
